Commentary.Commentary: Marsh removed the SA skipper and once the big hitters were out of the picture, Australia made a fine comeback with the ball. Hastings and Marsh played crucial roles in the Australian bowling attack, picking up 3 and 2 wickets respectively. The remaining bowlers did their best to keep the runs down but it was never an easy task on a wicket such as this. This might be a high target but the game isn't yet over as Austraila have a very strong batting lineup. Join us shortly for the run chase.

Rossouw hung on to score 75, playing a supporting role to the stand-in skipper. Faf du Plessis made a great return to form, scoring 111, after getting struck on the thumb by an errant throw. South Africa kept on adding the runs but things were really taken up a notch when JP Duminy got into his stride to send the ball flying into the stands. He brought up a rapid 82 off 58 balls and a 150-run partnership with du Plessis.

That ends an action-packed South African innings. They added 97 runs in the last ten overs though to finish on a very strong note. After their fireworks in the first ODI, big things were expected from the duo of de Kock and Rossouw. They got off to a solid start but Hastings got a huge breakthrough for Australia when he picked up de Kock's wicket.
Beaten! Slower full ball outside off, Parnell swings and misses. Wade quickly collects the ball and denies the batsmen a single. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 361/6!
Too short and too wide outside off, could have left it alone but Phehlukwayo cuts it over point for a single.
Big swing! Tremain bowls a full ball outside off, Andile gives a big swing of his bat but could only hit the thin air.

SIX! Going... going.. gone! Incredible hit that! Back of a length delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo stands tall and muscles it straight down the ground for a biggie all the way. My word, that was a classy hit.
Fuller ball on off, Phehlukwayo looks to hit it over covers sitting down on one knee but fails to do so.
FOUR! Clean strike! Good length delivery on off, Andile makes a good connection as he sends it back overthe bowler's head for a boundary to start the final over. Vital runs these.
Hurls it on the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single. Hastings figures now read as - 10-0-57-3!
Fullish in the channel on off, lofted towards long off for a single.
Good length ball outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Andile looks to slog but fails to put any bat on it.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is the new man in.

OUT! Hastings gets a 3-fer! Bowls a full ball outside off, Miller looks to slice it through the off side but gets it off the outer part of the bat and it goes straight to Zampa at backward point. There is no response from the fielders first but then Zampa says it's out. The umpires wanted to have a look if the ball bumped before travelling to zampa. Replays show it didn't. Miller walks back and hits some shrubs while he walks back to the dressing room.
Miller is caught at deep backward point but the umpire wants to see if the ball bumped or not.

FOUR! Killer Miller! Yorker going wrong as Hastings serves a juicy full toss on off, right under the bat of Miller and he slams it over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary to start the penultimate over.
Serves it wide outside off, Miller comes down the track and drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller ball on off, eased down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Meaty blow! Short of a length delivery on middle, Parnell rides the bounce and pulls it on the up through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length ball outside off, Miller runs it down to third man for a couple.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
WAYNE PARNELL is the new man in!

OUT! In the air... gone! Maiden ODI wicket for Tremain! Bowls it on a length around middle, Farhaan looks to slog it across the line but completely mistimes it. The ball skies up towards deep backward square leg where David Warner settles underneath it. He doesn't miss many and Behardien has to depart. Can Australia restrict the home side under 350?
TREMAIN is back on.
In the air and... safe! Full around off, lofted over mid on. The fielder at long on is a bit too deep and does not make it in time. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot for a couple.
Yorker outside off, dug out to the covers.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
FOUR! DRILLED! Full outside off, Miller steps up to the pitch of the ball and square drives it for a boundary.
Shortish delivery, Behardien plays a pull shot through the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a brace.
Shortish ball outside off, Miller looks to pull it but misses. Marsh is varying his deliveries well.
Full around off, driven through mid off for a single.
FOUR! MISFIELD! Shortish ball on middle, flicked through fine leg. An uncharacteristic misfield from the man at fine leg and the ball goes to the boundary. A big cheer erupts from the crowd.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. Good variation.
Back of a length ball on off, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Fullish ball on middle and off, well driven to mid off for a single.
FOUR! SUPERBLY TIMED! Slower full delivery outside off, Miller picks his sport and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Full around off, driven down the ground.
Full on off, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Quick delivery outside off, Behardien looks to play it but misses.
JOHN HASTINGS is back into the attack!
Well bowled! Yorker on off, Miller could only dig it out on the off side. A superb over from Mitchell Marsh!
On a length and outside off, punched past covers for a single.
Farhaan has punched the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length ball on off, defended off the front foot.
FARHAAN BEHARDIEN is the next man in!

OUT! Got him! That spells the end for Faf du Plessis. What a knock from him though. Marsh bowls a length delivery on middle, comes up at a nice height too. du Plessis looks to slog, middles it but it goes straight down the throat of Steven Smith stationed at deep mid-wicket. How easy he made it look. Nevertheless, double M gets his second wicket.

In the air... but in the no man's land! Marsh rolls his finger on that one, Faf looks to flick but the ball takes the top half of the bat and the ball balloons towards mid-wicket. There is no one there and Marsh himself runs to get to the ball. Two runs picked up.
Miller once again goes for the pull but misses the line and is hit on the pads.

FOUR! This time gets what he wanted! He was trying to hit in that area from the start of this over and finally gets it. Another short ball going down leg, Miller swivels and pulls it down to fine leg. The outfield is such that it races away to the fence.
Another short ball down the leg side, Miller just help it on its way down to fine leg and comes back for a double this time.
On a length and outside off, Faf makes room and punches it through covers for a single. Brings up the 300 for his side!
Shortish on middle and leg, Miller pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Wide! Short and hurled down the leg side, Miller swivels in the crease to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked towards short fine leg for a single.
DAVID MILLER is the new man in! The stage is set for him and he can start to cut loose from the word go...

OUT! DUMINY DEPARTS! Edged onto the stumps! Full around off, Duminy is seeing red now, charging down the track to give it a full swing of his bat. The ball takes an inside edge and carroms onto the stumps. That was a lightning fast innings from JP and Australia will be glad to see him walk back.
150-run stand for Duminy and du Plessis.

FOUR! 3 in a row! Length ball wide outside off, the southpaw looks to play it but the ball takes an outside edge and races past the slips. It gets past the outstretched hands on the keeper and goes to the third man boundary.
FOUR! Duminy does not want to stop! Full outside off, Duminy charges down the track and drives it hard through the covers for a boundary.
SIX! CLOBBERED! A yorker gone wrong from Marsh, Duminy lofts that full toss over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full length ball outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, du Plessis strikes it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Marsh is back on.
Full toss outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Shortsh ball on the pads, nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
SIX! CLEANLY STRUCK! Without any sixes so far, now we see two in an over! Fullish ball on middle and off, Duminy stays in his crease and bends his front leg to loft it over mid-wicket.
Change of angle and a slower bouncer on middle, Duminy looks to pull it but misses.

SIX! MASSIVE! First maximum of the innings! A low full toss on the stumps, Duminy stays back and lofts it. It looked huge from the moment it left his bat and flies over mid-wicket and into the stands.
Length ball on off, tucked to fine leg for a single.
The last POWERPLAY has been signalled.
Good length delivery on off, Duminy winds up for a big swing across the line only to get beaten.
Driven through mid off for a single.
6th ODI century for Faf du Plessis!

There it is, what a knock by Faf! A thoroughly deserving ton for this man. Remember he got hurt on his thumb when he came on to bat but he continued to bat and proved he is a brave lad. Removes his helmet and acknowledges the cheers from the crowd. Short of a length ball on off, cut through point for a double.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short of a length delivery on middle, du Plessis gets across and pulls it through fine leg for a boundary. Moves onto 99 now and the crowd is right behind the skipper now.
On middle and off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length delivery on off, Duminy leaves it alone.
Full on middle and off, driven to long on for a single.
Back of a length around off, Duminy was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.

Shortish ball outside off, pushed to the covers. Faf goes for a single but Marsh at covers is quick to throw the ball at the bowler's end. The ball misses but had it hit, Faf would have been in real trouble.
Full on off, driven through mid off for a single.
23rd ODI fifty for JP DUMINY.
FOUR! 50 for Duminy! Shortish ball around off, JP Duminy gets down on one knee and drags it across to the mid-wicket boundary. Duminy raises his bat as he appreciates the crowd.
Length ball outside off, Duminy opens the face of the bat and plays it to point for a single.
Mennie is back on.
Shortish ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
100-run stand between JP Duminy and Faf du Plessis.
Wide! The ball goes way wide outside off and the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! LOFTED! Fullish ball outside off, the southpaw plants his foot forward and aims to go over the top. There is no one at long off and the ball crosses the ropes.
Bouncer! JP does well to evade it.
Length ball on the pads, du Plessis looks to play it but is hit on the pads. The batsmen run a single but the umpire signals a leg bye.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot to the covers.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
TREMAIN is back on.
Short ball outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full outside off, driven to the covers.
FOUR! DRAGGED! Short around off, du Plessis makes no mistake with the length this time, pulling it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shortish ball outside off, du Plessis looks to pull it but misjudges the length and makes contact with the bottom half of the bat. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Landed on the stumps, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Loopy and full ball on the stumps, driven down the ground for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, nudged to mid-wicket for a single. Partnership is 83 of 72 balls.
Back of a length ball outside off, dapped to the man at point.
Fuller ball on off, Duminy shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball around off, played to point.

FOUR! One bounce to the boundary! JP Duminy is well into his stride now. Full outside off, JP charges forward and slogs it down on one knee. The ball flies over the covers for a boundary. This is not looking too good for Australia now.
Drops it a touch short on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Tossed up ball around off, JP comes down the track and goes inside out over covers for a brilliant boundary.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Around off, du Plessis pushes it towards point.
Flighted ball around off, Faf comes down the track, doesn't quite gets to the pitch of the ball but still manages to hit it over the bowler's head for a couple.
Flatter one around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! SMASHED! Short around off, Duminy swivels in place and pulls it strong mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Length ball on middle, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven down the ground for a single.
Short ball on middle and off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Drinks break!
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Tosses this one outside off, du Plessis makes room and lofts it over the man at extra cover. The fielder comes sprinting to his left, puts in a dive but to no avail.
On middle and leg, driven towards long on for one.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, driven through covers for a single.
Loopy ball around off, driven hard but finds the man at short covers.
200 up for 200! Flatter one around middle, played down the ground towards long on for a single.
Fuller ball on off, driven towards covers for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Landed outside off, Faf opens the face and glides it down to third man for a single.
Short and outside off, cut down through point for a single.

FOUR! 50-run stand comes up between the two! Fuller in length and around off, Duminy comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid off. Hastings tries his best to take it with his left hand but the ball was way over him. JP gets a boundary.
Banged short on off, Duminy has got nothing to with that one.
MARSH is back on!
Full and around off, bunted back to the bowler off the inner half of the bat.
Flattish on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Driven through the cover region for one.
A googly around off, Duminy gets forward and drives it through the square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Tossed up around middle, JP punches it towards covers.
Loopy full around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
ADAM ZAMPA is back into the attack!
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Edged away! Loopy delivery around off, turning away a bit. Duminy looks to steer it down to third man but gets an outside edge past the vacant slip cordon for a boundary. Really lucky there, Duminy!
Darted on middle, worked through the leg side for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Tossed up ball around leg, it hits one of the foot mark and spins viciously down the leg side. Faf leaves it alone and the keeper had no chance to stop that one.
Full and around off, pushed straight to the man at covers.

In the air... falls short! Tossed up around middle and off, Duminy doesn't quite get to the pitch of the delivery but still carries on with the lofted shot. It goes aerially over extra cover and Marsh tries his best but the ball falls short of him. A single is taken.
Loopy ball around off, driven down the ground towards long off for a single.
Good length delivery on the pads, tucked towards square leg for a couple.
Faf drives it through mid off for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fuller length delivery on off, pushed towards covers.
Good delivery on off, played towards point.
FOUR! Top edge but safe! Good length delivery outside off, Duminy looks to swipe it on the leg side but gets a top edge which flies down to fine leg for a boundary.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy ball around off, du Plessis looks to drive but fails to put any bat on it.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, du Plessis looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards covers.
FOUR! Creamed! Loopy and outside off, Faf literally pounced on it as he creams it through the gap at covers for a boundary. Easy pickings those.
Good running between the wickets! Loopy delivery around middle, Faf gets back and flicks it in front of the square on the on side and comes back for a double.
TRAVIS HEAD comes into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Faf opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single to keep strike.
Angles a length delivery on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball on off, pushed towards covers.
Banged short on middle, Duminy ducks to evade it.
Good length ball on off, touch full as well, Duminy pushes it on the off side.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven down the ground towards long off for a single.
Full outside off, played to point for a single.
FOUR! BEAUTIFULLY PLAYED! Du Plessis comes down the track to turn that yorker into a half volley. He punches it down the ground, making proper contact with the full face of the bat for a boundary.
Good variation! Slower ball outside off, Faf prods at it and is beaten by the pace.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball on the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
23rd ODI fifty for FAF DU PLESSIS.
Full on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball around off, defended to the off side. Good over for Hastings.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
WIDE! Bouncer outside off, Duminy leans back to avoid it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Fullish ball around off, played off the front foot.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back to the off side for a single.
JP DUMINY is the new man in.

OUT! TOP EDGED AND CAUGHT! Rilee will be disappointed with that. Fullish ball outside off, Rossouw looks to slog it but the ball takes a top edge and is sent skywards. Worral is standing at mid-wicket and he positions himself underneath the ball. It slips through his hands but he manages to trap it before the ball touches the ground.
HASTINGS is back on.
FOUR! Up and away! Fuller ball on off, du Plessis comes charging forward and lofts it down the ground. Steven Smith makes a valiant effort to save it but fails to stop the boundary.
Full outside off, the southpaw looks like he was going to paddle but changes it up at the last moment to flick it through the leg side for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle, flicked neatly through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, dabbed towards third man by Faf for a single.
Fuller length delivery on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
TREMAIN is back on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on off, driven to long on for a single.
FOUR! A repeat from the last over! Full outside off and pitched up. Faf plays it inside out and the ball goes over mid off for a boundary. It looks like he was waiting for that one.
Loopier delivery outside off, driven to the covers.
Full on middle and off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Short outside off, waits late and punches it off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Full outside off, flicked to mid-wicket for a couple.

FOUR! ROCKED! Rossouw really punished that one! Full around off, Rilee makes good use of the feet, coming down the track and driving it. He hits it with a lot of pace and the ball goes down the ground for a boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, beautifully punched off the back foot to the covers but the batsmen only get a single.
Faf works it down the leg side.
Short ball around off, pulled with real authority to the man at mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, driven to mid on.
Flighted on middle and off, defended with an angled bat to the off side for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven straight back.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Zampa overcompensates for the previous delivery, bowling it short around off. Faf cuts it through square and finds the gap for a boundary.
FOUR! INSIDE OUT! Full delivery outside off, Faf stays back and lofts it over the infield and it goes across the boundary at mid off.
Floated outide off, played off the front foot. Well bowled.
Landed outside off, played to covers.
Fullish ball outside off, played to point.
Length ball outside off, played with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Faf gets in on the action! Full outside off, du Plessis charges down the wicket and lofts it over mid off. The ball bounces back down in the deep and crosses the ropes.
Full around off, driven to mid off.
Back of a length ball outside off, the southpaw punches it off the back foot to covers for single.
Shortish delivery on the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
JOE MENNIE is back on.
Short and outside off, cut towards backward point for a single.
Short and flat on middle, pulled towards the left of the bowler.
Flattish around middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Rilee drives it towards mid on for another single.
Full and around leg, driven down to long on for one.
Loopy around leg, driven towards short mid-wicket.
Rilee has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Good length delivery on off, Rossouw comes a step ahead and punches it back to the bowler. He was down the track and Marsh immediately gets to his left and tries to run the batsman out but he fails to collect.
Angles in from outside off, Rossouw looks to cut but misses.
Wide! Banged short on middle and leg, it's too high to trouble the batsman.
Full and around off, sliced straight to point.
Short of a length ball on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single. 100 up for SA!
Landed outside off, Rossouw opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Short and around middle, pulled towards backward square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed towards covers for one.
Around middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Flattish around middle and off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Short and around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
ADAM ZAMPA to roll his arm.
Drinks break...

FOUR! Finds the gap! Fuller length delivery on middle, slightly overpitched actually. Faf gets across and flicks it between backward square leg and fine leg. Two men come to cut it off but the ball wins the race. It was all about timing on that shot.
Back of a length delivery on off, Rossouw makes room and punches it towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.
A low full toss on the pads, Rossouw looks to flick but is hit on the pads as the ball rolls on the leg side.
Angles it on the pads, Roassouw flicks it towards backward square leg and comes back for a double.
Gets behind the line and defends it on the off side.
Touch short and outside off, cut straight to the man at backward point.
FOUR! Fab from Faf! Sees a length delivery served outside off, immediately gets down the track and lofts it neatly over extra covers for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, punched towards covers. Faf is running at the danger end as a throw is fired at the striker's end. It's off target and a single is taken.

Good length delivery outside off, Rossouw comes down the track to cut but it goes off the outer half of the bat towards third man. Finch in the deep is a bit sloppy as he takes his eyes off the ball which allows the batsmen to take a couple.
Fuller length delivery on off, Rilee gets forward and defends it towards covers.
Good length delivery on off, punched straight to point. A dot ball to end the over.

FOUR! Uppish but safe! Good length delivery in the channel outside off, a bit of extra bounce as well. Faf gets back and pushes this one through point. The fielder dives full length to his right but the ball goes through for a boundary.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot.
Comes from over the wicket now and bowls it full on off, du Plessis digs it out.

Risky single! Angles a length delivery on off, Rossouw taps it on the leg side and sets off for a single. Marsh gets to the ball and tries to throw it at the striker's end but hits Faf again. Really risky running, that.
Angles a length delivery on off, Rossouw comes a step forward and defends it down.
Length ball outside off, driven through mid off.
Shorter ball outside off, defended off the front foot.
Length ball around off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
7th ODI fifty for RILEE ROSSOUW.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers. The crowd roars as the batsmen cross for a single.
Shorter ball outside off, defended to point. Rilee looks to take a single but is sent back. He is on 49 now.
Shortish ball on the stumps, de Plessis nudges it. He doesn't have any room and the ball goes high off his bat to square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball around off, defended off the front foot with the full face of the bat to cover.
Pitched outside off, a bit of extra bounce on offer. Rilee defends it off the back foot.

Faf du Plessis is down in pain as Finch fired a throw at the bowler's end but it hits Faf on the wrist who is down. The physio is out and is giving the required treatment to the Protea skipper. He is all set to bat again.

Fuller ball outside off, du Plessis drives it through mid off. The batsmen run a single. Finch at covers aims a throw at the non striker's end. He misses the stumps but it goes to du Plessis who is across the line. Faf raises his hand to block it but is hit on the thumb. He is on his knees and his hands are visibly trembling. Hope he is able to continue batting. The physio has had a look at it and he has a bit of tape on his hand now. The crowd cheers lustily when he walks back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller ball outside off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
MITCHELL MARSH comes into the attack.
Skipper FAF DU PLESSIS is the next batsman in.

OUT! THE DANGER MAN DEPARTS! Fullish ball outside off, de Kock lofts it. He is not able to middle the ball as it goes off the toe end of the bat. It is lofted over the bowler's head but doesn't quite clear mid on. Tremain runs to his right and takes a comfortable reverse cup. Australia will breathe a big sigh of relief as de Kock walks back.
Short ball outside off, cut through point.
Fullish ball on middle and off, Rossouw looks to defend it off the back foot and gets a thick inside edge to the leg side. The batsmen pick up a single but that ball nearly got through.
Back of a length ball outside off, opens the face of the bat and taps it past the keeper to short third man for a single.
Length ball around off, punched off the back foot to deep extra cover.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to cover for a  single.
Good ball to finish the over. Length ball outside off, Rossouw fails to put bat on ball.
Full outside off, de Kock does well to flick it to the leg side for a single.

Mennie is lucky to get away with that! Short ball outside off, lots of width on off. De Kock cuts it through point and it goes past the fielders but the man in the deep saves the runs. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, played to the leg side.
FOUR! ROCKETED! Fuller ball outside off, de Kock drives through the covers. It races past the fielder who has no chance as it goes for boundary.
Full on middle, driven to mid on.
Length ball on the stumps, worked down the leg side.
Fuller ball outside off, played to point.
Fullish ball on off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Better bowling from Hastings.
FOUR! TOP EDGED! Short ball outside off, Rossouw takes the invitation. He frees his arms and has a swing at the ball but gets a top edge and the ball crosses the ropes at third man.
FOUR! PUT AWAY! Slightly short ball outside off, a bit of width. Rilee punches it off the back foot and the ball races to the boundary at covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot.
JOHN HASTINGS to bowl.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rilee punched is off the back foot to the covers. The fielder at covers still aims a direct hit at the striker's end but the batsmen just go for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! EXCELLENT TIMING! Fuller ball outside off, Rossouw plants his foot forward and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, cut to third man for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, dabbed towards third man for a single.

Hits the timber but at the other end! Fuller in length and on the stumps, Rossouw drives it dead straight down the ground and it hits the stumps at the other end. de Kock was inside the crease but the ball deflects off the stumps and goes on the off side. The duo now cross over for a single.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller and angling in, Rossouw drives it towards mid on and shouts 'WAIT ON' straightaway.
Good length delivery on off, Rossouw plays it off the outer part of the bat towards point.
Tad full and around off, de Kock drives it through covers and scampers across for a quick single.

TOSS - AUSTRALIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BOWL. South Africa are unchanged. Australia have made 2 changes to the side - Joe Mennie and Chris Tremain make their international debuts while Scott Boland and Daniel Worrall will sit out.

The Johannesburg wicket looks to be a belter. The visitors have not had much time to reassess and South Africa will look to continue with their winning momentum. So buckle up as this match has all the signs of being another run fest.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd match of the 5-match ODI series between South Africa and Australia at the Wanderers, Johannesburg. South Africa decimated Australia in the first ODI with a record-breaking knock by Quinton de Kock. Australia's confidence, just like it's bowlers, has taken a beating and they will most likely attempt a couple of changes. Their batting was strong enough to set a decent total but South Africa were in a league of their own.
